note: Real consumer evidence, replayed. Every SHA, path list and ancestry relation below was read from reitojike/stage-tracker on 2026-09-06 with the GitHub compare API — none of it is synthesised, and no product PR was created to manufacture a base drift (Issue #102, Consumer validation). The `expected` block records what the deterministic half of the fence must conclude from these facts alone; it deliberately never records a semantic conclusion, because these facts do not contain one.

cases.title: Design refactor: 選択日リストのpresentationを3実装から1つへ寄せる (Issue #315)
cases.story: The reviewed head 57137c39 was a single commit on issue-315-presentation, frozen against main tip 6afd3458. While it sat, PR #313 (the PWA installable shell) merged and moved main to ed53dd79. What actually happened next is the friction this Issue is about: the agent merged the advanced main into the branch as 4908998e, which changed the head SHA and forced precondition / Selection / discovery to be re-established from scratch.

expected.note: Every mechanism-owned fact holds. The route still does not open, because no agent has judged the semantics.

cases.title: Design refactor: 行内バッジの縮まない規約を1箇所にする (Issue #311)
cases.story: Reviewed head 76bb8c46 frozen against main tip cb153de5. Main then advanced to 6afd3458 by merging PR #306 (CI workflow) and PR #320 (Issue #317, shared visually-hidden declaration). Because the branch had already integrated part of that main, and because #320 touched the same shared UI surface, the reviewed artifact set and the intervening artifact set intersect directly.

expected.note: Forward-only and completely acquired, but the two deltas touch shared artifacts. The mechanism removes this candidate before any semantic verdict is consulted.

cases.title: The same two commits compared in the other direction
cases.story: The identical pair of real commits, with the frozen base and the tip transposed — the shape a base branch reset or force-push would produce. GitHub reports the relation as `behind` with ahead_by 0.

expected.note: A base that moved backwards is never a forward-only drift, whatever the artifact sets say.

semantic_observation.note: Case pr-321-forward-only-disjoint is also the clearest available argument for keeping the semantic half with the agent. Its two deltas are artifact-disjoint by path, yet PR #321 rewrites src/ui/selectedDayList.module.css while the intervening delta edits src/ui/__tests__/Row.test.ts — the test file of the very component whose presentation #321 consolidates. Both changes are also instances of the same in-flight convention (consolidating repeated small UI declarations), which main went on to write down as 8581089f docs(ux-ui). No path comparison can see any of that. A checker that read disjointness as semantic safety would have called this candidate safe.
